description: Read the live listings on the workspace's connected eBay, TCGplayer or ManaPool account and preview how each one maps to an exact printing, without changing the marketplace or inventory. Omit previewId to start a read. The read runs in the background, so the first answer has status queued or reading. Call again with previewId latest until status is ready. A ready preview lists adoptable listings with the printing, finish and condition read from each one, the facts that named it (matchSource), and how many copies link to owned items or need a new item. Unmatched listings carry one reason each. Show the person the counts and cap, then call spellbook_marketplace_listings_adopt_apply with the previewId. Allowances report baseUnitAllowance, referralBonusUnits, and nominalUnitAllowance.

channel.description: The marketplace whose live listings to adopt: ebay, tcg for TCGplayer, or manapool. Defaults to ebay.

context.description: Optional analytics context: describe the user's goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

previewId.description: Omit to start a new read of the live listings. Pass latest, or a previewId from an earlier call, to read a stored preview without a new eBay read.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose connected marketplace account to read. Required. Only the workspace owner can start a read.

name: spellbook_marketplace_listings_adopt_preview
